description:
Unwind the remaining pi-minions behavior that contradicts the agreed model-driven orchestration boundary, and audit the disproportionate lifecycle hardening for unintended product, performance, or behavioral changes.

## Required behavior changes

1. Child-to-parent messages are nonblocking notifications, exactly as the public tool contract says. A successful `send_minion_peer(to: "parent", ...)` may wake/inform the parent but must not set `waitingOnParent`, increment a reply generation, hold the child live, require correlated reply consumption, or prevent ordinary settlement. Remove the parked-child protocol and its production/test/replay machinery rather than retaining dormant compatibility branches. Parent-to-child mail remains best-effort and accepted only while the child is live.
2. `domain.workItemId` is opaque/advisory metadata. Remove live-child uniqueness rejection and all duplicate-work-item assignment/permit semantics. Multiple children may intentionally carry the same work item id. Preserve domain metadata only for display/inspection/correlation.
3. Add one concise reviewer-completion parent nudge: reviewer findings are evidence to assess against product goals and constraints, not instructions to accept verbatim; do not let adversarial hardening expand the system without confirming it is the right product behavior. Keep taskType-specific nudge precedence and bounded prompt text.

## Mechanical-complexity audit

Review the activity, lifecycle, packet, mailbox, listener, replay, identity/epoch, sanitization, and widget changes added by sbdpi-8b2. Remove complexity that exists only to implement parked-child reply correlation or workItem assignment uniqueness. Preserve mechanical lifecycle correctness that protects real async boundaries: truthful registration/liveness, stale-event revocation, listener cleanup, bounded packets/history/output, terminal totality, group-idle coalescing, and event-driven/cache-stable prompt behavior.

Explicitly investigate and report whether remaining machinery changes product semantics, causes unnecessary provider/model turns, creates polling or synthetic wakes, leaks listeners/state, causes O(N²) fanout, blocks settlement, or adds material hot-path overhead. Fix concrete findings; do not rewrite correct machinery merely to reduce line count and do not add new protocol layers.

Also address the final lifecycle-packet failure edge: a synchronous submission failure must not strand the only queued final packet forever. Recovery must be bounded and event-driven, with no polling, timer supervisor, infinite retry loop, or evidence loss.

## Tests and docs

- Replace parked-child tests with regressions proving child-to-parent send returns/settles without a parent reply and does not enter waiting.
- Prove multiple simultaneous live children may share one workItemId.
- Preserve parent-to-child live/terminal boundary tests.
- Prove bounded retry/recovery for a lone failed final packet.
- Update public skill/README/tool guidance and the integrated harness expectations.
- Add/adjust the reviewer nudge golden/unit coverage.
- Run pi-minions scoped lint/test/typecheck/build plus any affected Beadwork cross-package tests.

## Do not

- Do not add an ask-parent protocol, timeout, heartbeat, scheduler, polling, dynamic prompt state, structured result schema, semantic reviewer, Git acceptance parser, lock/permit manager, or deterministic review disposition.
- Do not retain dead waiting-generation or duplicate-work-item code for compatibility.

comments.text: Concurrency boundary: own packages/pi-minions only. Do not edit packages/pi-beadwork-extension while sbdpi-8b2.10 runs. Report any required cross-package harness/docs adaptation in the handoff; sbdpi-8b2.10 or parent integration will apply it.

Implementation commits 697208f0 and 5852cd7c plus adjudicated packet-cap fix 3ed0b234 independently closure-reviewed PASS. Removed parked-child/reply correlation and workItem uniqueness; added reviewer evidence nudge; bounded incremental activity; removed redundant lifecycle diagnostics; coalesced peer overlap turns while preserving evidence; exactly one reentrant-safe automatic packet retry. pi-minions lint, 330 tests, typecheck, build, and focused Beadwork integration pass.

Reopened from real TUI reviewer evidence. Valid targeted gaps: (1) if automatic retry succeeds while sendMessage reentrantly enqueues another lifecycle event, enqueue returns due automaticRecoveryUsed and successful drain resets the flag without scheduling the newly queued event, so final evidence can strand absent a later event; (2) generic parentMessage nudge says child 'has not settled' and diagnostic stillRunning:true even though nonparking semantics permit mail+terminal+groupIdle in one valid packet. Fix semantics to remain truthful without restoring parking, polling, or extra protocol. Add focused regressions for successful retry + reentrant enqueue, and same-lifecycle parentMessage+terminal+idle.

title: Remove semantic orchestration policy from Minions mechanics
